description: Deletes the user action for the given Id. This permanently deletes the user action and also any history and logs of the action being applied to any users. OR Deactivates the user action with the given Id.

X-FusionAuth-TenantId.description: The unique Id of the tenant used to scope this API request. Only required when there is more than one tenant and the API key is not tenant-scoped.

userActionId.description: The Id of the user action to delete.

name: deleteUserActionWithId
